content.title: About
content.content: Ranch dressing fat free is a classic American sauce based on buttermilk but without added fats. It retains the characteristic creamy taste with hints of herbs, garlic and spices while providing minimal calories and virtually no fat.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Ranch dressing was created in the 1950s in the United States as a salad dressing.
The fat‑free version appeared in the early 2000s as consumers sought lighter options.
Classic Ranch is commonly used as a dip for vegetables, chicken nuggets and french fries.
The fat‑free formula usually contains buttermilk, vinegar, spices, dry milk solids and flavor enhancers.
Ranch is the best‑selling sauce in the U.S. by volume.

items.title: Low calorie content
items.content: Fat‑free Ranch provides about 30–40 kcal per 30 ml, making it suitable for calorie‑restricted diets.

items.title: Contains probiotics
items.content: The buttermilk base supplies live cultures that support gut health.

items.title: Source of B‑vitamins
items.content: Dairy components deliver modest amounts of riboflavin (B2) and cobalamin (B12), important for energy metabolism.

items.title: Provides calcium
items.content: Buttermilk is rich in calcium, which helps maintain strong bones and teeth.

items.title: Reduced sodium in some versions
items.content: Certain brands offer a low‑salt formulation, beneficial for blood pressure management.

items.title: Milk allergy
items.content: Contains dairy proteins and may trigger reactions in individuals allergic to milk.

items.title: Artificial additives
items.content: Some products use flavorings and preservatives that could be undesirable for sensitive consumers.

items.title: Lactose content
items.content: People with lactose intolerance may experience discomfort even with small amounts.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Fat‑free Ranch works well as a salad dressing, vegetable dip, chicken breast topping, or dip for baked potatoes. It can also be spread on sandwiches or used in marinades for a gentle flavor boost.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store in the refrigerator at 2 °C–4 °C. After opening, consume within 2–3 weeks. Do not freeze, as the texture may change.
